title: `global` statement used to cache the auth plugin
detail: Line 37 uses a `global` statement to cache a module-level auth plugin instance. Module-level mutable globals make unit-testing harder (requiring explicit reset between tests) and create thread-safety concerns if the module is ever imported in a multi-threaded context before initialisation. Suggested fix: use a module-level sentinel (e.g. `_AUTH_PLUGIN = None`) with a thread-safe initialiser, or inject the plugin as a dependency.
